messages:
Anya: Quick Q — we're about to land a change that adds model_revision into the prefix cache key. Is that a breaking change for older SDKs that won't send model_revision? Also: how do we surface cache hits for streaming responses? Need a compatibility/rollout plan before I merge the PR.

Sam: Short answer: avoid breaking. Server should canonicalize keys when fields are missing (fall back to model). For streaming hits it's trickier — headers are easiest for sync responses, but streaming may need an event or a trailer.

Jordan: Agree on non-breaking fallback. Two practical options for streaming: 1) emit `x-rw-cache-hit: 1` as an initial header if the whole response is served from cache; 2) for hybrid cases (prefix cached, then generated), emit a small stream event like `:cache-hit: prefix` or a final trailer `x-rw-cache-hit: partial`. Note browser support for trailers is sketchy.

Maria: From SRE POV: we also need the hit flag in logs/traces so offline billing and metrics pick it up. For invalidation: we need both TTL-based expiry and a delete API. If we do eventual-consistent deletes across regions, document expected windows.

Sam: Proposed canonical cache key composition (server-side canonicalization):
```
key = sha256(concat_normalized([
  model || '',
  model_revision || '',
  normalize(prefix_text),
  tenant_id || '',
  stringify(sorted(requested_params_subset)) // e.g. max_tokens, stop, temperature if relevant
]))
```
Notes: - normalize(prefix_text) = NFC unicode, trim multiline whitespace, collapse repeated spaces. - exclude request_id, client_timestamp, ephemeral debug flags. - hash the full normalized prefix to keep key length bounded.

Anya: For backward compatibility, can we accept both v1 (no model_revision) and v2 keys for ~30 days? Add response header `x-rw-cache-key-version: v2` when v2 used so SDKs can opt-in. Also add a server-side fallback to compute both keys and check either bucket.

Jordan: Rollout suggestion: feature-flag `prefix-cache-v2` gated on customers. Steps: 1) server computes both keys for reads (cheap) and continues writing v1 for old flows; 2) enable writes for v2 behind flag; 3) after 30 days, flip reads-only to prefer v2 and then remove v1. I'll open a PR with the flag wiring.

Sam: Streaming hit semantics: - If full cached response: set `x-rw-cache-hit: 1` header and short-circuit streaming. - If prefix cached + live suffix: emit initial `x-rw-cache-hit: prefix` header and send a stream event `event: cache-partial; data: {prefix_bytes: N}` or a JSON chunk `{"rw_cache_part": "prefix", "bytes":N}` so clients can attribute token counts. For clients that can't parse events, also include logs/traces.

Maria: Concern: client SDKs will need to handle the new event; otherwise UI can misattribute latency. Add backward-compatible fallback: if no event seen, treat as miss. Update SDK changelog.

Anya: PR is here: https://git.redwood/infra/prefix-cache/pulls/2451 (WIP) — main changes: key hashing util, `x-rw-cache-key-version` header, feature flag wiring, stream event emitter. Please review.

Jordan: I'll review this morning. Quick ask: add unit test that verifies both key formats hit the same cached item when model_revision absent.

Sam: Good call. Also add integration test for streaming partial prefix: simulate cached prefix + generated suffix and assert stream contains `cache-partial` chunk and trace span `prefix_cache_hit`.

Maria: Ops action item: document invalidation SLA per region and add a metric `prefix_cache_invalidation_lag_seconds`. I'll open infra ticket.

ops-bot: canary-deploy: prefix-cache-v2 -> 10% traffic at 2026-03-17T15:20:00Z :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary report: 0 errors in 10k reqs, latency p95 unchanged.

Anya: Awesome. After PR review + tests we'll enable flag for a small set of orgs. Thanks everyone — tagging for final thumbs up. :thumbsup:

Sam: LGTM, will leave small comments on the PR.

Jordan: Reviewing now.

Maria: Approved from SRE side once invalidation metric ticket is linked.

Anya: Merging scheduled after approvals. Will post follow-up with rollout checklist and SDK changelog notes.
